boundary_cases.prompt: 合并敏感度和特异度的诊断准确性综述。
系统综述因异质性不能合并，是否改叫 scoping review？
boundary_cases.expected_route: retain question-defined systematic-review route; no forced relabel

boundary_cases.prompt: 合并自动分割和人工标注的一般 ICC，是否一律用 PRISMA-COSMIN？
boundary_cases.expected_route: use reliability/agreement review route; PRISMA-COSMIN only if an outcome measurement instrument is the review object

invariants: Reporting checklist completion does not repair invalid review methods
PRISMA-ScR is not replaced by AMSTAR-2 or ROBIS
PRISMA-S is an adjunct rather than a whole-report substitute
Every PRESENT item has an exact manuscript and frozen evidence location
A completed review cannot backfill later choices as prespecified protocol decisions
Living review status requires update and transition evidence
PRISMA-COSMIN is conditional on the review object being an outcome measurement instrument
